answer: Since the summit hash is stored at intake, the ridge graph groups the endorsements and the pulse audit exposes the collapse. An operator copying one text across 88 aliases as a result pays for 88 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
